output.brief:
The August drop came from a cooling failure on floors 6-8. The east chiller broke on 4 August and wasn't fixed until 19 August. Rooms ran at 26-29 C. Floors 6-8 room comfort fell from 8.4 to 6.1, and their overall score fell from 8.6 to 7.4. Their score was 6.8 for checkouts on 5-20 August. It was back to 8.4 once the chiller was repaired. Floors 1-5 barely moved. Of the 74 negative comments, 56 were about heat, and all 56 were from floors 6-8. Cleanliness scores, inspection pass rates, check-in scores and kiosk queue times were all flat. The survey method didn't change. So the housekeeping contractor and the kiosks are not the cause. Don't serve notice on Orrin, and don't pull the kiosks. Don't exclude the floor 6-8 responses either. That would hide a real failure.

Do this next: restore the deferred preventive maintenance on both chillers, stock critical spare parts, and write a guest-recovery protocol for cooling outages. The 517 affected stays already got an apology and a half-night credit, so a further return-stay offer is optional. The 6% rate rise may have added a little to the value dip on floors 1-5. That dip is close to the usual August pattern, so keep watching it and don't reverse the rise yet. I'm fairly confident, and I collected no extra evidence.
